messages:
maria_cs: Quick draft tiny runbook for EmberCo (renewal demo). Need AE-friendly bullets + one prefills snippet. PTAL.

aj_dev: Keep it skimmable. Paste checklist here.

maria_cs: Checklist (one pager):
- Goal: deterministic demo latency and reversible quality changes.
- Leads: CS (maria_cs) + Eng enablement (aj_dev).
- 48h: reserve warm pool sized to projected 95pct concurrency.
- 6h: run prefill with demo prompts + tenant system prompts.
- 1h: dry-run end-to-end with streaming on.
- Recommended knobs for customer integrator:
  • prefill_ttl_sec=3600
  • batch_hint: {batch_size:8,max_latency_ms:50}
  • enable_stream=true, stream_fallback_ms=200
- Observability: confirm first-byte <150ms and capture 3 traces.
- Feedback: 3 q survey + opt-in to attach up to 2 anonymized transcripts (consent copy below).
- Escalation: if 95th latency >220ms OR hallucination spike -> switch to fallback model variant and notify CS-oncall.

elena_support: Add consent line for EU: "I consent to share anonymized transcripts for quality review." Use tiny.redwood/feedback-ember for the survey.

aj_dev: Prefill command for ops:
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/prefill"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"tenant":"emberco","prompt":"demo-seed","pool_size":8,"ttl_sec":3600}'
```

kevin_pm: Add two renewal metrics for AE slide: "FB latency <150ms" and "token cost delta <8% during demo". Also schedule a 3-day post-demo check-in to collect survey.

ops_bot: Reminder: reserve dedicated slot 2024-11-21T14:00:00Z for tenant 'emberco' — reply :thumbsup: to confirm.

maria_cs: Thanks — I'll run dry-run Tue 10:00 with aj_dev + elena_support then send one-pager to AE. Leaving this thread as the official short checklist + snippet + escalation path. :white_check_mark:
